successors.name: Tazabagyab Culture
successors.text: "in the territories of ancient Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan", "the semi-desert and desert areas of the Karakum and Kyzyl Kum deserts", "the deltas of the Amu Darya and Zeravshan rivers"

ledger.x: 5500 BCE: the Kelteminar fishers settle the Amu Darya and Zeravshan deltas and the Kyzyl Kum ("The Kelteminar culture (5500-3500 BC)").

certainty.note: Known from a desert site type and delta camps; no frontier is recorded.
